caesars.schedule_excerpt: At Caesars Palace, the daily schedule runs like clockwork. You will find four No-Limit Hold'em tournaments each day at 10 a.m., 2 p.m., 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. Every event carries a $100 buy-in, starts you with 20,000 chips, and features a $1,000 guaranteed prize pool.
